title: Lukethelucario`s Backrooms  Map Builder
description: wallpapers,lights and floors from the backrooms. V1.0.5 OUT NOW!!!
body:
A mod for mapmaking. adds a wallpaper,floor,lights,roof tiles and almond waters.really useful for when you want to make a backrooms map but you dont want to use a minecraft Rescource Pack.
Made in MCreator. if you want to use older versions then go to versions tab.
Fabric ports require Fabric
API(https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e3f346d37468f931ab1c83416b40fb2197a7fc6e.png)with [Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e3f346d37468f931ab1c83416b40fb2197a7fc6e.png) [Logomaker](https://www.textstudio.com/%22%3EFont%20generator%3C/a%3E)
